summary.headline: Planetary Configurations and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary configurations describe intelligence, learning, medicine, public and royal authority, military leadership, fame, envy, betrayal, instability, affliction, and reversals of fortune. The text treats combinations of Saturn, Venus, Mercury; Jupiter, Sun, Moon; and Jupiter, Mars, Sun or Moon, including effects of Mars aspects.
